purpose: Buggy engine for the federation: drive a vehicle over LiDAR and generated worlds for engineering checks and sales walk-throughs. Web ES modules the world imports as a cartridge, with CuPy/NumPy mirrors for pair checks.

dataProducts.name: buggy_catalogue
dataProducts.grain: one entry per cartridge, plug or engine

dataProducts.name: buggy_pair_receipts
dataProducts.grain: one receipt per pair run per engine

dependencies.purpose: Cartridge and plug catalogue schema; dual CuPy/NumPy engine rule; CI matrix pattern.
Lens and mount vocabulary for the chase and driver cameras.
The world imports src/web/buggy.mjs as its vehicle cartridge.

workflows.purpose: JS and Python tests, pair checks on NumPy with receipts as artifacts, catalogue and federation validation; an opt-in self-hosted GPU pair job.
